newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,730 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,730 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,730 contracts compared with 1,379 overnight Wednesday.
There were 89 wheat, 685 corn, 836 soybean, 31 soymeal, 46 soyoil, two oat, 26 corn calls and 15 soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/2 to four cents lower, corn was 2-1/4 to 3-3/4 cents lower and soybeans were three to eight cents higher.
